Definition: properly, to carve or engrave, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe indelibly
BiblicalUsage: Though thou wash thee with nitre and take thee much soap, yet thine iniquity is marked before Me, saith the Lord God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe no washing of my own can clean what only God can forgive.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
